mapper.select: SELECT source_id,identity_scope,identity_type,fingerprint_key_id,fingerprint FROM t_feedback_identity WHERE source_id IN #{sourceId} AND ((identity_scope='PERSON' AND identity_type<>'DEVICE_SN') OR (identity_scope='DEVICE' AND identity_type='DEVICE_SN')) ORDER BY source_id,identity_scope,identity_type,fingerprint_key_id,fingerprint
